verdict.rationale: Data export and portability is a fair question for an API platform that stores files, fine-tunes, evals and conversation state, so the axis applies. The evidence pack does not document any export tool, bulk data download, or open-format portability path; it covers only generation, tools, SDKs, batch, fine-tuning, pricing and key management.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
